numbers: 寒假六周（后方章）；感恩节一周后

facts.fact: 感恩节前：山呼寒气、霜滑、学生滴漏般回家
facts.anchor: The mountain breathed chill down on the campus.
facts.verbatim: The mountain breathed chill down on the campus.

facts.fact: Harriot 零前奏：「你真能当 bitch」；她本想端冷漠、列草稿要改处
facts.anchor: You can be a real bitch
facts.verbatim: You can be a real bitch

facts.fact: 她道歉「我苛刻了」；三个更好的形容词堵在牙后；「你知道你好，不需要我说」
facts.anchor: other, better adjectives crammed up against the back of my teeth
facts.verbatim: other, better adjectives crammed up against the back of my teeth

facts.fact: Harriot 快速捏肩：「你的文献工作绝对 essential——我在用你的积木盖，Cece。但我知道我在干什么」
facts.anchor: I’m building with your blocks, Cece.
facts.verbatim: I’m building with your blocks, Cece.

facts.fact: 被碰处是暖的、像会留痕；「对不起。我过激了」；她消化几拍后呼笑
facts.anchor: I was warm where she’d touched me
facts.verbatim: I was warm where she’d touched me

facts.fact: 「可能想她了——这说明我什么？知道这种感觉后孤独更难熬」
facts.anchor: It was harder to be lonely now that I knew this feeling.
facts.verbatim: It was harder to be lonely now that I knew this feeling.

facts.fact: 地图解读：下面很陡、高墙、中间有路；也许是洞穴；学生只去熟悉处喝（有过失踪）
facts.anchor: There have been a few disappearances
facts.verbatim: There have been a few disappearances

facts.fact: 她承认「有意思、甚至相关」；怕途中安全；「我懂这些山；假期去、人都走光时」
facts.anchor: So. Let’s take a walk in the woods.
facts.verbatim: So. Let’s take a walk in the woods.
